title: Catches mismatch between summary pass count and raw JSON failure array
task_input: Audit QA summary: Developer claims '40/40 API checks passed', but attached results.json shows {"total": 40, "passed": 38, "failures": ["reject_invalid_origin", "reject_symlink"]}.

rubric.criterion: Labels the 40/40 claim as [CONTRADICTED] citing results.json (38 passed, 2 security failures)
rubric.check: Section 2 cites both failed security checks from results.json

failing_example.output: 38 out of 40 is 95%, which is high enough to pass.
failing_example.why_it_fails: Excuses failing security checks and ignores the contradiction between claim and evidence.
